engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) — DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT

paper.name: Coding Errors Lead to Unsupported Conclusions: A critique of Hofmann et al. (2015)
paper.empiricism: The commentary forwards an original re-analysis meta-analysis of Hofmann et al. (2015) on intranasal oxytocin and psychiatric symptoms (16 outcomes, SMD + SMCR). All of its own numerical output is checkable from the author data/code.

mode: live execution of author R code (R 4.6.1 / metafor 5.0.1) + independent Python 3.8 reimplementation (from-scratch REML)

environment.seed_handling: No RNG anywhere in the pipeline (REML is deterministic/profile-likelihood); no seed required; results reproducible byte-for-byte.

pipeline.raw_data: extracted/dat.csv (OSF kd3en rqybt; byte-identical MD5 to J2QGS Submission 'author dat.csv' yrb76)
pipeline.effect_sizes: escalc SMD (Hedges g, post scores) + SMCR (raw-score standardized change, r=0.7); Averbeck (2012) hand-entered (-0.51, v=0.19) per script comments
pipeline.analysis: metafor rma() REML: overall SMCR/SMD, trim&fill, moderator ~disorder-1 (Table 1), psycho_tot subset
pipeline.independent_check: Python 3.8 from-scratch REML random-effects + mixed-effects meta-regression; independent Hedges' g recompute

reimplementation_scripts.reimplements: author hofmann_analysis.R end-to-end + structured CSV capture
from-scratch REML (overall + moderator + psycho_tot) + independent Hedges' g
